hero.title: Start with a clear role. Then build the course.
hero.description: MegaCampusAI helps you create a company-specific role guide and turn it into a practical learning course.
hero.roleProductDescription: 26 working sections for hiring, onboarding, and managing a role.
hero.courseProductDescription: Course structure, lessons, checks, and materials based on the role and your documents.
hero.workflowDescription: A role guide captures the role context; a course turns that context into team learning.

coursesLanding.metadataDescription: Create courses from role context, company documents, and practical team needs.

coursesLanding.description: First define what the person should do in the company. Then artificial intelligence helps assemble the course: structure, lessons, knowledge checks, and materials for your team.

coursesLanding.featuresDescription: Not a random lesson list, but learning tied to duties, decisions, and quality standards for the role.
